meta_description: Rowlands Decorators Manchester. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, professional finish. Call 07870 446747.
hero_subhead: Professional painting and decorating that transforms your home. Free quotes, no obligation, work you'll love.
services_heading: Complete Decorating Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: From interior redecorating to full exterior refresh, we handle every job with attention to detail and professional workmanship.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: We transform living spaces with precision work — walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. Includes surface preparation and colour advice to suit your home.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes that protect and refresh your home's facade. Includes masonry, render, timber, and uPVC work.

services.title: Wallpapering & Hanging
services.desc: Expert wallpaper selection and installation for any room. We prepare walls properly to ensure a crisp, long-lasting finish.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, frames, and built-in joinery painted to a professional standard. We use quality finishes that resist scuffing and wear.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Work
services.desc: Thorough preparation is the foundation of great decorating. We fill, sand, prime, and repair to ensure your finish looks flawless.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, retail units, and commercial spaces decorated on schedule with minimal disruption. We work flexibly around your business hours.

about_pullquote: We turn up on time, finish the job properly, and treat your home with respect.
about_para_1: Rowlands Decorators has been transforming homes across Manchester for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many rushed jobs and poor finishes — we decided to do it differently. Our team takes pride in the detail work: proper surface preparation, quality materials, and a finish that lasts.
about_para_2: Our customers come back to us because we listen. We offer honest colour advice, stick to timescales, and clean up properly when we're done. Whether it's a single bedroom or a full commercial refit, every job gets the same attention to detail.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Rowlands Decorators

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs painted and wallpapered. The lads were here five days, and they worked really efficiently. Cleaned up every day, moved furniture sensibly, and the finish is spot on. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: We were nervous about getting the exterior done but Rowlands took all the worry out of it. They prepped properly, used quality paint, and the house looks brilliant. Fair price too. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Helen P.

reviews.text: Our kitchen needed freshening up and we didn't know where to start with colours. They gave us proper advice without being pushy, and the work was immaculate. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: Mark S.
